page.overview:
What is Leather?

Leather is an item used to make item frames, armor and books.

Upon death, cows, mooshrooms, horses, donkeys, mules, llamas and trader llamas drop 0–2 leather, while hoglins drop 0–1 leather. The maximum amount is increased by 1 per level of Looting, for a maximum of 0-5 leather (4 leather from hoglins) with Looting III.

A fox has a 20% chance to spawn holding leather, which always drops upon death. Alternatively, a player can drop a food item, causing the fox to drop the leather.

Leather can be obtained as a "junk" item from fishing.
